task_objective: Preserve instance environment overrides when executor calls add per-call overrides
design_decisions: Applied environment precedence in the order process, instance, then call.
Copied resolved mappings before applying call overrides so caller and executor state remain unchanged.
Preserved the existing behavior where a call override without instance configuration merges onto os.environ.
results: The regression tests failed before implementation because instance overrides were absent, then all 13 core tests passed after the fix.
